Azure OpenAI returns a 401 Unauthorized error when the API key is missing or invalid — uses Azure's error envelope shape with code AccessDenied

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
begin
  api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
  client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
  result = client.chat_async(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'Hello', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'azure/gpt-4'))
rescue StandardError => error
  warn "#{error.class}: #{error.message}"
end
```
